# Automation API reference

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/automation-docs.mjs` from the method registry. Do not edit by hand; `pnpm check:automation-docs` fails when this is out of date. -->

API version **1.0**. Every method is a JSON-RPC 2.0 request on the socket (Linux) or named pipe (Windows); `recso-cli call <method> '<json params>'` sends one, and `recso-cli mcp` offers each as an MCP tool named with `_` for `.`. See [README.md](README.md) for turning the API on and connecting, and [agent-guide.md](agent-guide.md) for driving recso from an agent.

## Contents

- [recso-cli](#recso-cli)
- [Settings](#settings)
- [Methods](#methods)
- [Events](#events)

## recso-cli

```text
Usage: recso-cli [global flags] <command> [options]

Global flags (may appear anywhere):
  --json                 Print JSON results and errors
  --launch               Start recso if it is not running
  --socket PATH          Use a specific socket or named pipe
  --timeout MS           Wait this long for --launch (default: 30000)
  -h, --help             Show help
  --version              Show CLI API version

Commands:
  status | describe | version | show
  call <method> [json]
  record start [--source ID] [--out DIR] [--name NAME] [--system-audio|--no-system-audio] [--mic|--no-mic] [--mic-device ID] [--camera|--no-camera] [--camera-device ID] [--remember-source]
  record stop | pause | resume | state
  sources forget
  projects list [--dir DIR] [--limit N]
  projects get <dir> | open <dir>
  export <projectDir> [--out FILE] [--preset NAME] [--encoder auto|hardware|software] [--overwrite] [--wait]
  export progress <exportId> | cancel <exportId> | wait <exportId> [--timeout-ms N]
  settings get [key...] | set key=value [key=value...]
  devices
  events [name...]
  mcp
  help [topic]
```

## Settings

Read with `settings.get`, changed with `settings.set`. They last until recso quits, and the recorder window shows them.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recording.outputDir` | string | `"<Videos>"` | An absolute path. |
| `recording.systemAudio` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `recording.mic` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `recording.micDeviceId` | string \| null | `null` |  |
| `recording.camera` | boolean | `false` |  |
| `recording.cameraDeviceId` | string \| null | `null` |  |
| `export.outputDir` | string \| null | `null` | An absolute path. null resets it. |
| `export.preset` | "720p-low" \| "720p-medium" \| "720p-high" \| "720p-lossless" \| "1080p-low" \| "1080p-medium" \| "1080p-high" \| "1080p-lossless" \| "4k-low" \| "4k-medium" \| "4k-high" \| "4k-lossless" | `"1080p-high"` |  |

### `devices.list`

MCP tool: `devices_list`

**Linux:** One source, kind "portal": the desktop asks which screen or window when recording starts, unless a source is remembered (rememberedSource).

**Windows:** The primary screen and each open window, by id; recording.start({ sourceId }) records one without asking. rememberedSource is null.

### `recording.start`

Start recording. recso's recorder comes to the front and shows the recording as if its button had been pressed; either side can stop it. Unset options come from the settings. Returns once capture is running.

MCP tool: `recording_start`

**Linux:** Without a remembered source the desktop shows its picker and the call waits for the choice (cancelling fails with reason "cancelled").

**Windows:** rememberSource is not supported and is ignored: sources are chosen by id.

Params:

- `sourceId` (string, optional): From devices.list; the primary screen when unset.
- `outputDir` (string, optional): Absolute. Overrides recording.outputDir.
- `fileName` (string, optional): Name of the recording folder and video, without extension.
- `systemAudio` (boolean, optional)
- `mic` (boolean, optional)
- `micDeviceId` (string \| null, optional)
- `camera` (boolean, optional)
- `cameraDeviceId` (string \| null, optional)
- `rememberSource` (boolean, optional): Linux: let the desktop remember the chosen screen or window, so later recordings with rememberSource skip the picker until sources.forget.

<details><summary>Result schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "recordingId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "sourceId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "videoPath": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "rememberedSource": {
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "recordingId",
    "sourceId",
    "videoPath"
  ]
}
```

</details>

### `export.start`

Export a project to MP4 with its saved edits, as the editor's Export button would, without opening it. Returns at once with an exportId (follow it with export.progress, export.wait or the export.* events), or with wait: true once it has finished or timeoutMs has passed.

MCP tool: `export_start`

**Linux:** encoder "hardware" is NVENC and fails without an NVIDIA GPU; "software" is openh264.

**Windows:** Media Foundation picks the encoder (hardware when it can); encoder is accepted but doesn't change it, and encoderName stays null.

Params:

- `projectDir` (string, required): Absolute path of the project folder (the one holding .recso/project.json).
- `output` (string, optional): Absolute .mp4 path. Default: <export.outputDir or the project's exports folder>/<project name>.mp4, numbered if taken.
- `preset` ("720p-low" \| "720p-medium" \| "720p-high" \| "720p-lossless" \| "1080p-low" \| "1080p-medium" \| "1080p-high" \| "1080p-lossless" \| "4k-low" \| "4k-medium" \| "4k-high" \| "4k-lossless", optional): Default: the export.preset setting.
- `encoder` ("auto" \| "hardware" \| "software", optional): "auto" (default) uses the GPU encoder when there is one.
- `overwrite` (boolean, optional): Replace an existing output file. Without it, an existing output fails.
- `wait` (boolean, optional)
- `timeoutMs` (integer, optional): min 0

<details><summary>Result schema</summary>

```json

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "exportId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
```

### `events.subscribe`

Receive these events (all of them when events is omitted) as JSON-RPC notifications on this connection, whose method is the event name and params its payload. Replaces an earlier subscription.

MCP tool: `events_subscribe`

Params:

- `events` ("recording.started" \| "recording.stateChanged" \| "recording.stopped" \| "export.progress" \| "export.finished" \| "export.failed" \| "project.saved" \| "settings.changed"[], optional)

<details><summary>Result schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subscribed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "subscribed"
  ]
}
```

</details>

### `events.unsubscribe`

Stop receiving events on this connection.

MCP tool: `events_unsubscribe`

Params:

None.

<details><summary>Result schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "subscribed": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "subscribed"
  ]
}
```

</details>

## Events

Sent as JSON-RPC notifications to connections that called `events.subscribe` (`recso-cli events` prints them one per line), and to the hooks in `automation.json`.

### `recording.started`

A recording started, from the API or from recso itself.

<details><summary>Payload schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "recordingId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "sourceId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "videoPath": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "recordingId",
    "sourceId",
    "videoPath"
  ]
}
```

</details>

### `recording.stateChanged`

The recorder went to recording, stopping (finalising the file) or idle.

<details><summary>Payload schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "recording",
        "stopping",
        "idle"
      ]
    },
    "recordingId": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "state",
    "recordingId"
  ]
}
```

</details>

### `recording.stopped`

A recording was stopped and its file finalised (success true), or it failed. projectDir is the new project.

<details><summary>Payload schema</summary>

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "recordingId": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "success": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "projectDir": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "videoPath": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "durationMs": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "clicks": {
      "type": "integer"
    },
    "error": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "recordingId",
    "success",
    "projectDir",
    "videoPath"
  ]
}
```

</details>
